name: SER 2027 poster: rabbits and wildcats in the Greater Côa Valley
description: Code, figures and text for an A0 poster for the 12th SER World Conference on Ecological Restoration (Lisbon, 2027, Lands in Motion). Version 0.2 asks whether the European rabbit, the European wildcat's main prey, can be restored inside the corridors the wildcat already uses in the Greater Côa Valley, Portugal. Three maps: the land connectivity of the species group that includes the wildcat (after Fig. 4 of the workflow preprint, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22979020), and a rabbit habitat screen inside those corridors, with ten priority survey blocks, and the Natura 2000 sites around the study area in Portugal and Spain. Every figure on the poster is computed from the Côa Valley Eco-Connectivity v6 data bundle. These are screening maps, not release sites.
softwareRequirements: GDAL (gdalwarp, for the first remote raster fetch)
